search.description_short: Searches downloaded scripts for a set of criteria

display.description_short: Displays a list of characters of the given script that match the character types given (if provided)

format.description_short: Creates a pdf of the given script

upload.description_short: Uploads, checks and formats a script.json file
upload.description: Uploads, checks (only if -i flag is not present) and formats a script.json file
